principle: A longest stage is only a time concentration; a binding bottleneck must also limit reliable completions under the frozen marginal and failure/rework criteria.

time.candidate: stage has median exclusive active-plus-attributed-wait share >=0.25
time.binding: candidate criterion AND removing its observed duration in a prespecified queueing replay increases all-gates-valid throughput >=15%; bootstrap 95% CI lower bound >0

failure.candidate: stage accounts for >=0.30 of attributable terminal failures or is modal first-failure stage
failure.binding: candidate criterion AND stage-specific pass probability is lower than every other required gate by >=0.10; paired bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0

rework.candidate: stage originates >=0.30 of rework loops or rework active time
rework.binding: candidate criterion AND counterfactual removal of its attributed loops increases acceptance yield >=0.10; bootstrap 95% CI lower bound >0

throughput.candidate: stage has highest observed utilization in the frozen single-server flow model
throughput.binding: utilization >=0.80 AND its service capacity has the largest prespecified marginal throughput gain; gain >=15% with bootstrap 95% CI lower bound >0

coordination.candidate: coordination/approval wait or active time share >=0.20 OR candidate-selection/reconciliation causes >=0.20 of rework
coordination.binding: candidate criterion AND high-minus-low increase is >=0.10 absolute share or >=20% time, with paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0

stage_binding_rule: A stage is binding for a type only when both that type's candidate and binding clauses pass within a repository-by-task-class stratum. Cohort-level binding requires the rule in at least 2 repositories and 2 task classes without a significant opposite-direction interaction.
migration: Migration requires implementation to be binding for at least one primary type in the lower-capacity condition, cease to bind for that type under higher capacity, and a named non-implementation stage newly bind for that same or another primary type. It also requires the manipulation check and artifact controls. Merely becoming the longest stage is insufficient.
